gates.reason: Exercises bounded LLM context, source-body exclusion, and clean SPA omission without handling credentials or introducing an unsafe sink.
Cap arithmetic, recommendation totals, severity counts, and non-ready-state handling are asserted consistently with the implementation.
Test-only fixtures and assertions are not shipped hot-path code.
LLM-bound context is bounded, excludes source bodies, and does not read or select OAuth credentials; no write, injection, or client-rendering sink exists here.
Recommendation claims are projected into LLM context without their evidence, evidenceRefs, provenance, or proof metadata.
Outputs use fixed top-N/token caps; repo-map assembly stops at a constant budget and other aggregation work is linear or bounded sorting.
Covers credential, key, SSH, and paste-cache denial; secret precedence; path normalization; and shipper drift.
Tests path security classification, not recommendation evidence, arithmetic, stale signals, or validated fix snippets.
Small test fixture loops are not shipped hot-path code.
Secret patterns are checked before shippable session-data patterns, including nested credentials, paste-cache, SSH material, and common private-key extensions.
This is an egress-security path classifier, not detector/parser/calculation code producing recommendation claims.
Classification performs two small fixed regex scans and linear path normalization with no unbounded recomputation.

findings.title: Ask Claude recommendation projection discards auditable evidence and provenance
findings.what: The projection sends title, detail, action, savings, and affected-count claims to the LLM but drops the Recommendation fields that make those claims reproducible: evidence, evidenceRefs, provenance, claimClass, proofTier, and related attribution. The resulting context can prompt the model to repeat or prioritize claims without an artifact/field trail or as-of metadata.
findings.fix: Include bounded structured evidence and provenance fields in each projected recommendation, preserving artifact/field observations, inference, as-of date, and proof/attribution metadata while retaining the overall context cap.
findings.acceptance: A recommendation carrying evidence, evidenceRefs, provenance observations with artifact/field and asOf, plus claimClass/proofTier is passed through buildContext; the resulting bounded JSON preserves those fields and a test asserts their exact presence.
findings.verifyNote: Adversarial re-read confirmed the baseline mapping at src/lib/claude-context.ts:403-414 enumerates only id, category, severity, title, detail, action, estSavingsUsd, and affected. The candidate is current and reproducible; no later code in this file restores evidence or provenance.
